notes.title: Major Update on 4th Jan: Unlock of Scene 5 & 6
notes.content:
Happy New Year to all players!

We sincerely apologize for an error on our part that caused Scene 5 and subsequently Scene 6 to remain locked after completing Scene 4. This led to a very disappointing experience for many players. After our prompt efforts to resolve the issue, the game is now functioning properly.

If you have already completed Scene 4, you can now immediately unlock Scene 5 upon entering Scene 4 without having to replay it. If you have not yet completed Scene 4, this update will not affect your current progress.

We will learn from this incident and conduct more thorough testing before future game launches. We deeply regret any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding.

Best wishes,
MindPalace Team
